verdicts.evidence: The middle "Woodland loop" card has a large serif title, an amber outlined pill button and square corners. Its padding is about 15 px against about 33 px on the other cards, and its title, text and button all sit higher than the matching lines in the cards beside it.
In all three cards the content ends at the buttons around y 390, but the cards run to about y 598, so the lower part of each card is empty.
